relations.rationale: Gathering before setting off provides context for later sightings but doesn't affect the woodpecker claim's likelihood.
Ivo and Uma being on different teams doesn't determine whether Uma and Dara are on different teams.
Team assignment of Ivo and Uma is unrelated to Otto's arrival time.
Team assignment of Ivo and Uma has no bearing on Otto's boots being muddy.
Ivo and Uma being on different teams doesn't logically determine Ivo and Dara's team relationship.
That Ivo and Uma are on different teams implies at least two teams exist, which is consistent with but doesn't confirm exactly three teams.
Team assignment of Ivo and Uma has nothing to do with relative ages of Otto and Ivo.
A heron sighting near a bridge the previous week is unrelated to Uma's kingfisher story on this occasion.
Uma and Dara's team assignment has no bearing on Otto jogging to catch up.
Uma and Dara's team assignment is unrelated to Otto's muddy boots.
Uma and Dara being on different teams doesn't determine whether Ivo and Dara are on different teams.
Uma and Dara being on different teams implies at least two teams, weakly supporting existence of multiple teams but not specifically three.
Otto arriving last supports the idea that he would need to jog to catch up with the others.
Otto arriving last doesn't explain why his boots are muddy.
Otto jogging through terrain could plausibly cause muddy boots, supporting the squelching description.
Otto jogging to catch up is unrelated to Pia's comment about lighting for photography.
Otto's muddy boots have no bearing on Dara spotting a woodpecker.
Pia's comment about good light for photographing warblers could prompt Uma's agreement, supporting that she nodded.
Pia mentioning good light for warblers could prompt Ivo to raise his binoculars to look for them.
Ivo and Dara being on different teams implies at least two teams, weakly supporting existence of multiple teams but not specifically three.
